name: 僕らとおいしい韓国語 パンモゴッソ?
original_name: 僕らとおいしい韓国語 パンモゴッソ?
overview: An educational variety show on WOWOW On Demand blending Korean language learning and food culture, hosted by ATEEZ’s YUNHO and ONE N’ ONLY’s HAYATO, featuring casual conversational lessons through cooking, dining together, and exploring authentic ingredients.
